timezone_help: Timezone for daily, monthly, and yearly reporting. Default: Europe/Berlin.
solar_sources_help: Configure multiple inverters or PV strings. Their power values will be summed.
battery_power_help: Internal sign convention: positive = discharging, negative = charging. Use 'Invert sign' if your device reports positive = charging.
battery_invert_help: Enable if your device reports positive = charging.
battery_grid_charging_help: When disabled, grid charging is excluded as an installation assumption. Contradictory measurements will produce a visible conflict.
battery_grid_export_help: When disabled, battery export to grid is excluded as an installation assumption.
battery_energy_charge_meter_help: Data point with the total energy charged into the battery (kWh).
battery_energy_discharge_meter_help: Data point with the total energy discharged from the battery (kWh).
grid_sign_convention_info: Internal sign convention: positive = grid import, negative = grid export.
grid_power_help: Select an object measuring the grid balance. Positive = import, negative = export (or use 'Invert sign').
grid_invert_help: Enable if your device reports positive = export.
house_power_help: Measured household consumption. If not available, consumption is calculated from Solar + Grid + Battery.
balance_tolerance_help: Maximum accepted discrepancy between measured and calculated household consumption.
ev_charging_meter_help: Cumulative meter of charging energy. Must grow continuously (not just per session). If unavailable, power will be integrated.
ev_threshold_help: Minimum power (W) to detect active charging.
ev_included_in_household: Charging energy is included in household consumption
ev_included_help: Enable if your household meter includes the charging point. Prevents double counting.
history_detail_help: Time series of power measurements. Older data is automatically deleted.
diag_info_text: Diagnostic states are available in the object tree under energy-flow.X.diagnostics.
